note: A capability-scoped boundary, in the shape a zero-retention product mode takes. tts-cache-legacy and agents-scratch carry no selector at all, and stt-preview carries a value the profile does not define — all three are unattributed, which fails. The agents capability is declared in scope but nothing is attributed to it, which is the gap no per-resource item would show. Telephony and third-party LLM are declared out with a named attester, because no cloud API can confirm a capability is switched off.

boundary.description: Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text and Agents, in Zero Retention Mode only. Third-party model and telephony integrations are outside the boundary and disabled by default.

out_of_scope.name: Third-party LLM integrations
out_of_scope.excluded_by: Disabled by default and unavailable on the government tier; enabling requires a per-tenant change outside the boundary.

out_of_scope.name: Telephony integrations
out_of_scope.excluded_by: Not deployed in the government environment; the integration is absent rather than disabled.
